title: XML Formatter
h1: XML Formatter — Pretty Print and Validate XML
seoTitle: Free XML Formatter — Beautify and Validate XML Online
description: Format, beautify and check XML structure in your browser. Indent tags, catch basic errors and copy clean output. Private and free.
intro: Paste raw XML to format it with proper indentation and see a clear status if the structure looks valid.
blurb: Format and beautify XML with proper indentation in the browser.
howItWorks: Paste your XML into the input box.
The tool pretty-prints the XML if it is well-formed.
examples: Turn a single-line XML payload into readable nested tags.
Check basic structure before pasting into a config file.
Make API response XML easier to read.

faq.q: Does this send my XML to a server?
faq.a: No. Everything runs locally in your browser. Your data never leaves your device.
It checks basic well-formedness. For full schema validation use a dedicated validator.
